notes: TESTToken takes no constructor arguments and mints the entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 TEST with 18 decimals to msg.sender once at deployment. It has no transfer taxes, owner, admin, post-deployment minting, burning, proxies or upgradeability. Every successful transfer, including transferFrom, self-transfers and zero transfers, emits TransferRunningTotal(address sender, uint256 cumulativeAmount) with the sender's cumulative gross transferred amount in minor units. transferFrom attributes the total to the token holder, not the spender; constructor minting is excluded. Launch distribution and pool seeding are external to TESTToken. Pool fee 12500 represents 1.25% in Uniswap v4 fee units. initialPrice is provenance only; the opening price is derived from the economics and deployed currency order.
